cluster_summary: A wide range of cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerabilities caused by failing to neutralize user-supplied data—either through HTML entity encoding, input sanitization, or input validation—before it is embedded in web pages. The cluster includes reflected, stored, and JSONP-based XSS, with fixes ranging from global input filters to per-field encoding and strict allowlist validation.
guideline_text: Trace attacker-controlled template text, expression strings, macro content, or rendering parameters into template engines, expression evaluators, macro renderers, or scriptable configuration evaluators. Report code paths where untrusted expression content is evaluated without sandboxing, escaping, allowlisting, or disabling reflective execution features. Confirm that the guard is enforced before the sensitive effect and remains bound to the same resource, principal, destination, or object that the effect uses. Treat this as a reusable mechanism-level pattern derived from 2 historical CVE example(s), not as a project-specific signature. A safe implementation should separate data from templates, sandbox expression evaluation, and disable reflection or method invocation features for untrusted input.

mechanism.missing_guard: untrusted expression content is evaluated without sandboxing, escaping, allowlisting, or disabling reflective execution features
mechanism.name: untrusted template or expression evaluation
mechanism.sink_shape: template engines, expression evaluators, macro renderers, or scriptable configuration evaluators
mechanism.source_shape: attacker-controlled template text, expression strings, macro content, or rendering parameters
mechanism.typical_fix: separate data from templates, sandbox expression evaluation, and disable reflection or method invocation features for untrusted input

sub_patterns.fix_strategy: Apply input validation (regex allowlist, @Pattern, bean validation) or sanitization (Jsoup.clean, OWASP HTML Sanitizer, tag stripping) to reject or neutralize dangerous HTML characters before they are stored or reflected.
sub_patterns.name: missing input validation/sanitization using allowlists or tag stripping
sub_patterns.root_cause: Trust that user input contains only safe characters; no validation or sanitization is performed before storage or reflection, allowing injection of HTML/JavaScript.
